gloss: each time; every time; on each occasion

definitions.gloss: each time; every time; on each occasion
definitions.explanation: Every time a particular situation occurs, the action is performed anew. Emphasizes repeated action in response to recurring events.

examples.japanese: その{都度|つど}⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I deal with it each time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きたら→起きる：00521_okiru⟧その{都度|つど}⟦{報告|ほうこく}して→報告する：05644_houkokusuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please report every time a problem occurs.

examples.japanese: ⟦まとめて→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧なもの⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧その{都度|つど}⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{無駄|むだ}→無駄：02512_muda⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: Rather than buying in bulk, it's less wasteful to buy what you need each time.

notes:
USAGE:
A versatile expression used in both formal and informal contexts. ⟦{都度|つど}→都度：14408_tsudo⟧ means "each time" and is bound with ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧ (that) to form this adverbial phrase. Can also appear without ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧ in more formal writing: ⟦{都度|つど}→都度：14408_tsudo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧ (to confirm each time).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- その{都度|つど}⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to handle each time)
- その{都度|つど}⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧ (to check each time)
- その{都度|つど}⟦{報告|ほうこく}する→報告する：05644_houkokusuru⟧ (to report each time)
- その{都度|つど}⟦{払|はら}い→払い：18738_harai⟧ (pay-as-you-go)
